mechanism_claims.entity_scope: screened peptides 58, 98, 201, 615, 623, 1304; peptide 68 excluded from single-molecule analysis because labeling altered permeability behavior

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is cross-assay contextual support, not a standalone direct cellular mechanism.

caution_findings.finding: Direct mechanism support is from model membrane/liposome/bilayer assays; final curation does not claim a specific intact-cell molecular target or pore stoichiometry in bacteria.
Source-supported pore-forming subset is peptides 615, 623, and 1304; all seven are not promoted to pore-forming peptides.
